evals.prompt: Choose a built-in editor preset for long-form articles with inline code and relationships.
evals.expected_output: Select article explicitly and explain its versioned defaults.
expectations: Selects article rather than a hidden default.
Notes headings h2 through h5 and depth one.
Uses overrides only for actual differences.

evals.prompt: Create an organization preset, mutate the original heading array, and reuse it in two editors.
evals.expected_output: Use defineEditorPreset and verify snapshot immutability and fresh providers.
expectations: Does not create a global registry.
Tests both consumers through the public interface.

evals.prompt: Make relationship depth five the default in compact and standard presets.
evals.expected_output: Reject the expensive generic default and require explicit consumer opt-in.
expectations: Keeps relational defaults at depth one.
Notes compact has no relationship feature.

Adds a contract test for exact sizes.

expectations: Keeps preset selection separate from native append.
